## Key Sections

### Experience
- **Co-Founder & CTO, Taktora Inc. (Nov 2024 to Present, Los Angeles, CA):** Co-founded Taktora, an AI copilot ("Cursor for factory scheduling") that adapts production plans to real-time floor conditions. Deployed the MVP to 2 factories ($40K ARR). Member of Confluent AI Accelerator Cohort-3. Built a multi-agent scheduler that combines LLM agents with OR-Tools constraint solving and reads live counts and deviations from edge-deployed vision, cutting weekly production replanning from 5 hours to 30 minutes. Developed a real-time multimodal factory assistant using LiveKit with voice and vision on iPad, backed by RAG over machine manuals and SOPs.
- **Founder & Technical Lead, Webbit Tech (Oct 2022 to May 2025, Macau):** Founded a 12-person digital studio that delivered web platforms and analytics dashboards for clients including Hovione, Galaxy Entertainment Group, and Macau government agencies. Scaled to $400K+ ARR within 18 months across 20+ projects. Shipped a ComfyUI-based generative image pipeline using SDXL and custom LoRA fine-tuning that cut asset turnaround from 3 days to 0.5 days.
- **Data Scientist, Rainbow Seven Company Ltd. (Jun 2020 to Oct 2022, Macau):** Automated data extraction and analytics with Python RPA scripts on a cron schedule, replacing bimonthly manual IT requests with daily self-serve Power BI dashboards. Designed a headless promotional engine with micro-reward distribution that achieved a consistent 25%+ revenue lift at 300%+ ROI across three campaigns.
